conservative.requirements: Play when you die. Target within medium range (you may not target yourself). When you die, you may use this action. As you die, you whisper a final prayer to Shallya with your dying breath. The target within medium range (you may not target yourself) is completely healed: he recovers all normal and critical wounds, all fatigue, and all stress.

reckless.requirements: Play when you die. Target within medium range (you may not target yourself). Effect: When you die, you may use this action. As you die, you whisper a final prayer to Shallya with your dying breath. One target within medium range (you may not target yourself) is completely healed: he recovers all normal and critical wounds, all fatigue, and all stress.
